scope: Equipment: design: 19 F heating / 78 F cooling (bellingham); heating load 33,420 Btuh, cooling 1.06 tons (room-by-room, Manual J method); unit house: 42k ducted heat pump outdoor, 42k air handler in LAUNDRY, 21 supply registers, 2 returns, 5 kW strip; cold-climate variable-capacity heat pump(s), A2L refrigerant, HSPF2 >= 9.4 per the WSEC credit

Rough-in: line sets 34 ft (concealed), condensate to daylight, communication cable; ductwork 449 ft: trunks, flex branches, boots, returns, transfer paths; ventilation: exhaust 85.9 cfm continuous (WA M1505.4) - whole-house fan on a 24 h control, outdoor-air inlets; exhaust: every bath fan ducted and capped, dryer vent, range hood duct and cap - 28 ft

Trim, start-up and tests: registers and grilles, first filters, start-up and charge verification, controls set-up; tests: ventilation flow test, duct leakage test, the permit load calculation; inspections: Mechanical rough-in (cover), Duct leakage test, Ventilation flow test, Final mechanical
